verdict.rationale: Kit documents a webhook system with signed payloads (HMAC secret verification) and retry/backoff behavior, confirming webhooks are a supported integration mechanism, and separately exposes engagement stats like opens/clicks/unsubscribes via API. However the evidence never lists the specific catalog of webhook event types (send, open, click, bounce, unsubscribe) that can be subscribed to. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of supported webhook event topics, and independent/hands-on confirmation that engagement events (opens/clicks/bounces) actually fire as webhooks rather than just being queryable stats.
